indicator.name: County Executive audit opinion
indicator.description: Auditor-General categorical opinion on the County Executive financial statements for FY2023/24.
indicator.expected_source: Office of the Auditor-General — Summary Report on County Governments 2023/2024
indicator.expected_availability_note: Appendix 1(a) lists all 47 County Executives as Qualified for FY2023/24. The Atlas stores the category as text and does not convert it to a numeric score.

observations.notes: Categorical County Executive audit opinion copied directly from OAG Appendix 1(a), pp. 69–70. No numeric score, ordinal conversion or ranking is applied.
